structured.answer: I'm not changing anything. I'll keep my deposits at the bank and ask my son, then the clerk, whether a deposit really isn't insured and what breaking it early costs. The page didn't calculate that cost, and its example showed less money at the end (68,270) than was put in (70,000), which scared me.
